```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

df <- read.csv("data/capacity_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

POL_COLORS <- c(
  "round-robin"      = "#378ADD",
  "pf-classic"       = "#D85A30",
  "aoi-pure"         = "#1D9E75",
  "aoi-normalized"   = "#2DC4A0",
  "risk-aware"       = "#7F77DD",
  "max-weight-drift" = "#F4A261"
)
DARK_BG  <- "#1e1e2e"
PANEL_BG <- "#13131f"
TEXT_COL <- "#cdd6f4"
AXIS_COL <- "#a6adc8"
GRID_COL <- "#2a2a4a"

# Linha tracejada por K para distinguir sem precisar de filtro interativo
DASH_MAP <- c("1" = "solid", "2" = "dash", "4" = "dot", "8" = "dashdot")

make_ply <- function(d, y_col, y_title) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(plot_ly() |>
      layout(title = list(text = y_title, font = list(color = TEXT_COL)),
             paper_bgcolor = DARK_BG, plot_bgcolor = PANEL_BG))
  }

  agg <- d |>
    group_by(C, K, policy) |>
    summarise(y = mean(.data[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  pols_present <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(agg$policy))
  ks_present   <- sort(unique(agg$K))

  fig <- plot_ly()
  for (pol in pols_present) {
    for (k in ks_present) {
      sub <- filter(agg, policy == pol, K == k)
      if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
      show_leg <- k == ks_present[1]    # legenda só na primeira linha de cada pol
      fig <- add_trace(fig,
        data = sub, x = ~C, y = ~y,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
        name = pol,
        legendgroup = pol,
        showlegend = show_leg,
        line   = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol],
                      dash  = DASH_MAP[as.character(k)],
                      width = 1.8),
        marker = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], size = 4),
        hovertemplate = paste0(
          "<b>", pol, "</b>  K=", k,
          "<br>C = %{x}<br>", y_title, " = %{y:.3g}<extra></extra>"
        )
      )
    }
  }

  layout(fig,
    title  = list(text = y_title, font = list(color = TEXT_COL, size = 12)),
    xaxis  = list(title = "Capacidade C", color = AXIS_COL,
                  gridcolor = GRID_COL, tickvals = seq(10, 100, 10)),
    yaxis  = list(title = "", color = AXIS_COL, gridcolor = GRID_COL),
    plot_bgcolor  = PANEL_BG,
    paper_bgcolor = DARK_BG,
    font   = list(color = TEXT_COL, size = 10),
    legend = list(font = list(color = TEXT_COL, size = 9),
                  bgcolor = DARK_BG, tracegroupgap = 2),
    margin = list(l = 55, r = 10, t = 40, b = 45),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  )
}

tab_plots <- function(sc) {
  d <- filter(df, scenario == sc)
  list(
    h1     = make_ply(d, "mean_h1",          "AoI médio h₁ (slots)"),
    risk   = make_ply(d, "mean_risk",        "Risco médio total"),
    frames = make_ply(d, "frames_per_drone", "Frames entregues / drone"),
    util   = make_ply(d, "channel_util",     "Util. canal vídeo"),
    h2     = make_ply(d, "mean_h2",          "AoI médio h₂ (slots)")
  )
}
```

> **`r nrow(df)` runs** carregados · K ∈ {`r paste(sort(unique(df$K)), collapse = ", ")`} · C `r min(df$C)`–`r max(df$C)` · `r length(unique(df$policy))` políticas.
> Estilos de linha: **—** K=1 · **- -** K=2 · **···** K=4 · **-·-** K=8.
> Clique na legenda para ocultar/exibir políticas.

::: {.panel-tabset}
